#Question 1

```{r}
#1.1
eqdc <- '+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs'
```

```{r}
#1.2
remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundaries")
remotes::install_github("ropensci/USAboundariesData")
```

```{r}
remotes::install_github("ropenscilabs/rnaturalearthdata")
```

```{r}
#1.3
eqdc <- st_crs(5070)

states <- USAboundaries::us_states(resolution = "low") |>
  filter(!state_abbr %in% c("HI", "AK", "PR")) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)

countries <- rnaturalearth::countries110 |>
  st_transform(eqdc)

```

```{r}
#1.4
library(readr)
cities <- read_csv("uscities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)
```

#Question 2

```{r}

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(units)

states <- st_transform(states, 5070)   
cities <- st_transform(cities, 5070)
countries <- st_transform(countries, 5070)

#2.1 Distance to USA national border (coastline or international)
usa_border_geom <- states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities$dist_to_us_border_km <- st_distance(cities, usa_border_geom) %>%
  set_units("km") %>%
  drop_units()

ft_us_border <- cities %>%
  select(city = city, state = state_name, dist_to_us_border_km) %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_us_border_km, n = 5) %>%
  flextable()

#2.2 Distance to nearest state boundary 
state_boundaries <- states %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_combine() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities$dist_to_state_border_km <- st_distance(cities, state_boundaries) %>%
  set_units("km") %>%
  drop_units()

ft_state_border <- cities %>%
  select(city = city, state = state_name, dist_to_state_border_km) %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_state_border_km, n = 5) %>%
  flextable()

#2.3 Distance to Mexico
mexico_geom <- countries %>%
  filter(ADMIN == "Mexico") %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities$dist_to_mexico_km <- st_distance(cities, mexico_geom) %>%
  set_units("km") %>%
  drop_units()

ft_mexico <- cities %>%
  select(city = city, state = state_name, dist_to_mexico_km) %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_mexico_km, n = 5) %>%
  flextable()

#2.4 Distance to Canada
canada_geom <- countries %>%
  filter(ADMIN == "Canada") %>%
  st_geometry() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities$dist_to_canada_km <- st_distance(cities, canada_geom) %>%
  set_units("km") %>%
  drop_units()

ft_canada <- cities %>%
  select(city = city, state = state_name, dist_to_canada_km) %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_canada_km, n = 5) %>%
  flextable()

ft_us_border
ft_state_border
ft_mexico
ft_canada

library(ggplot2)
na <- filter(countries, ADMIN %in% c ("Mexico", "Canada", "United States of America")) |>
  st_as_sf()

big_cities <- cities |>
  slice_max(population, n = 10)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = na, fill = "grey") +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = "white", lty = 2, size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = big_cities, color = 'red', size = .5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = big_cities, aes(geometry = geometry, label = city, label.size = .1),
  stat = "sf_coordinates") +
    theme_void()
```
#Question 3

```{r}
#3.1
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

continents <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

top10_cities <- cities %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

conus_states <- states %>%
  filter(!state_name %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico"))

conus_outline <- conus_states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()  

names(conus_outline)[1] <- "geometry"
st_geometry(conus_outline) <- "geometry"


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = continents, fill = "gray95", color = "black", lty = 1, size = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = conus_outline, fill = NA, color = "black", lty = 2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "darkgray", lty = 3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = top10_cities, aes(size = population), color = "red") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_cities,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Largest US Cities with State & Continental Borders")

```

```{r}
#3.2
top5_us_border <- cities %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_us_border_km, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_to_us_border_km), size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = top5_us_border, color = "red", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top5_us_border,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Dist to US Border (km)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cities Colored by Distance to US National Border")

```

```{r}
#3.3
top5_state_border <- cities %>%
  slice_max(dist_to_state_border_km, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_to_state_border_km), size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = top5_state_border, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top5_state_border,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Dist to State Border (km)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cities Colored by Distance to Nearest State Border")

```

```{r}
#.4
library(gghighlight)

cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(dist_diff_can_mex = abs(dist_to_canada_km - dist_to_mexico_km))

equidist_cities <- cities %>%
  filter(dist_diff_can_mex <= 100)

top5_equidist <- equidist_cities %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray70", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = equidist_cities, aes(color = dist_diff_can_mex), size = 1) +
  gghighlight(TRUE, use_direct_label = FALSE) +
  geom_sf(data = top5_equidist, color = "purple", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top5_equidist,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Abs Diff: Canada vs Mexico (km)", option = "C") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cities Near Equidistant from Canada & Mexico (±100km)")

```

#Question 4

```{r}
#4.1
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

border_zone <- cities %>%
  filter(dist_to_us_border_km <= 160)

n_cities_zone <- nrow(border_zone)
pop_zone <- sum(border_zone$population, na.rm = TRUE)

total_cities <- nrow(cities)
total_population <- sum(cities$population, na.rm = TRUE)

pct_population_zone <- (pop_zone / total_population) * 100

border_summary <- data.frame(
  `# Cities in Border Zone` = n_cities_zone,
  `Population in Border Zone` = pop_zone,
  `Total US Population (Cities)` = total_population,
  `Percent in Zone (%)` = round(pct_population_zone, 2)
)

kable(border_summary)

```

```{r}
#4.2
library(ggplot2)
library(gghighlight)
library(ggrepel)

top10_danger_cities <- border_zone %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cities, color = "grey90", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = border_zone, aes(color = population), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred") +
  gghighlight(dist_to_us_border_km <= 160, use_direct_label = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(data = top10_danger_cities, aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
                   stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cities Within 100-Mile Border Zone",
       subtitle = "Top 10 Most Populous Cities Labeled",
       color = "Population")

```
```{r}
#4.3
top_city_per_state <- border_zone %>%
  group_by(state_name) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = population, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cities, color = "grey90", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = border_zone, aes(color = population), size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred") +
  gghighlight(dist_to_us_border_km <= 160, use_direct_label = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(data = top_city_per_state, aes(geometry = geometry, label = city),
                   stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Most Populous City per State Within 100-Mile Border Zone",
       color = "Population")
```
